triggers: a Metal kernel risks the 'committing a Metal command buffer twice hangs forever' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on Apple M-series Metal: committing a Metal command buffer twice hangs forever

problem.target: Apple Silicon (M-series) unified-memory GPU, Metal 4 toolchains
problem.statement: committing a Metal command buffer twice hangs forever

payload.attempted: A benchmark loop added a mid-loop commit+wait for a two-kernel pipeline while an unconditional commit+wait remained at the loop tail.
payload.lesson: Commit each command buffer exactly once; for multi-kernel sequences use two encoders on one buffer or two buffers with one commit each.

established_fact.mechanism: A command buffer may be committed exactly once; a second -commit on an already committed buffer is undefined and observed to block its waiters permanently.

payload.observed: waitUntilCompleted never returns; the process must be killed (stack shows pthread cond wait inside _MTLCommandBuffer).
payload.root_cause: A command buffer may be committed exactly once; a second -commit on an already committed buffer is undefined and observed to block its waiters permanently.
